messages:
nate_eng: seeing a spike of 500/503 from embeds-prod-eu starting ~11:02 UTC. tracing shows header-parser re-entrancy and kv-cache thrash under burst. built quick patch image v3.3.1-hotfix. requesting expedited micro-rollout (2%) with short soak. need ops + sre signoff.

deploy-bot: New deploy request: service=embeds-prod-eu image=v3.3.1-hotfix requester=nate_eng policy_default_canary=10% you can set `--canary 2` for micro-rollout. Approvals required: 2. Approve: `/approve deploy 1849999999` or react :white_check_mark:.

simran_sre: can we do 2% micro-canary + 4m observation. please attach prometheus snapshot and confirm no schema changes.

leo_ops: will approve if rollback artifact posted and ops playbook linked. i'll be on pager for 50m. set rollback image to v3.3.0.

nate_eng: rollback -> v3.3.0-stable, no DB or config changes. rollback steps quick: ```
# rollback
deployctl rollback --service embeds-prod-eu --image v3.3.0-stable
deployctl wait --stable embeds-prod-eu
``` runbook: https://playbooks/internal/embeds-hotfix-1849999999

anya_pm: product approves expedited micro-rollout. impact: intermittent failures for queued batch jobs in EU, medium severity. sending comms if deploy succeeds.

doc_bot: Draft release notes auto-created: "hotfix(embeds): mitigate header parser re-entrancy causing kv-cache thrash -> intermittent 503s (v3.3.1-hotfix)" edit at https://internal/releases/1849999999

simran_sre: /approve deploy 1849999999  approving conditioned on canary=2% and 4m soak.

leo_ops: /approve deploy 1849999999  approved. pager duty on. rollback command copied to my clipboard.

deploy-bot: Approvals (2) received. Starting controlled micro-rollout: canary=2% -> observe=4m -> promote. Command executed: ```deployctl rollout start --service embeds-prod-eu --image v3.3.1-hotfix --canary 2 --timeout 4m --requester nate_eng```

deploy-bot: Canary slices started. pods: embeds-v3-3-1-hotfix-a (Ready), embeds-v3-3-1-hotfix-b (Ready). telemetry stream: https://telemetry/internal/embeds/1849999999-canary

deploy-bot: Canary metrics after 4m: errors=0, p99 ~ 415ms (baseline 420ms), kv-cache misses back to normal. No traces of re-entrancy. Promoting to full rollout per policy.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Deployment status: SUCCESS. Release link: https://deployments.redwood/1849999999

nate_eng: monitoring dashboards for 60m. will escalate or rollback if anomaly. thanks all.

leo_ops: monitoring ok, no alerts. standing by for 45m.

simran_sre: added short-lived regression alert: p99 delta >20% OR error-rate >0.4% for 1h.

anya_pm: updated release note and notified comms. closing this thread in 1h if stable. great job everyone :tada:
